command:
export THREADS=16
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
T0=$(date +%s)
salmon index -t ensembl116_cdna.fa.gz -i sidx -p "${THREADS:-16}" --ramLimit 8 > index.log 2>&1 \
  || { tail -20 index.log; exit 1; }
T1=$(date +%s)
tar -cf salmon-index.tar sidx
rm -rf sidx                      # a directory THIS task built -- safe to remove
{ printf 'salmon_version\t%s\n' "$(salmon --version 2>&1 | awk '{print $NF}')"
  printf 'index_wall_s\t%s\n' "$(( T1 - T0 ))"
  printf 'index_tar_bytes\t%s\n' "$(wc -c < salmon-index.tar)"
} | tee index-stats.txt
test -s salmon-index.tar
echo "INDEX OK"
